leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic long polling endpoint using Node.js HTTP server
Configure request timeouts to manage long polling connections
Initialize and maintain a pending requests queue for client connections
Construct response logic that sends updates when data becomes available
Manipulate response headers to control client-side polling behavior
Integrate fallback mechanisms when long polling connections expire
Apply error handling for connection interruptions and client disconnects
